description: This file defines configuration structures and static methods for managing relay settings in the ShareGateway component of an application. It includes a data model for relay configuration, along with functions to load, save, and clear configuration and event data using UserDefaults.

classes.name: ShareGatewayRelayConfig
classes.description: A data structure representing the configuration for the relay gateway, including URL, token, password, session key, and optional delivery details.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the relay configuration from UserDefaults, decoding it from JSON.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the given relay configuration to UserDefaults, encoding it as JSON.

methods.name: clearConfig
methods.description: Removes the relay configuration from UserDefaults.

methods.name: saveLastEvent
methods.description: Records the last event message with a timestamp into UserDefaults.

methods.name: loadLastEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the last event message string from UserDefaults.
